display_name: Pimen the Much-Ailing of the Caves

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 7 Αυγούστου, «Όσιος Ποίμην ο εν τω σπηλαίω ο Πολύπαθης», with the rank words and the epithets left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue’s fourth heading for the Julian 7 August, „Преп. Пимен Многоболезнени.“ — Преп. left off, which §5 maps to `venerable`. **Многоболезнени is kept**: it is not a rank, it is in no table of §5, and it is the whole of what distinguishes him from the three other Pimens this corpus keeps and from the faster of the same Lavra, whom the Greek keeps on this same day. `.tmp/sr-foldpred.mjs` reports the two-word form folds with nothing.

Name page 1792 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Преподобный Пимен Многоболезненный»; «Преподобный» is a rank word and is stripped, and the calendar gives no surname. The day line gives the genitive «Пимена Многоболезненного, Печерского». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE, and the bare «Пимен» was out of the question with a second Pimen on the same page.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 7 августа ст. ст. — «Прп. Пимена Многоболезненного, Печерского (1110).»

attestations.note: The day's tenth entry and the same menologion day as the folder's Greek and Serbian rows; the year «(1110)» is the year the folder already holds. HE IS NOT THE OTHER PIMEN ON THIS PAGE: the day's twelfth entry is «Прп. Пимена, постника Печерского (XIII-XIV)», who is `pimen-the-faster-of-the-caves`, a different man of a different century with his own troparion printed below this one's, and that folder already carries a VENERATED russian row on the Julian 27 August and was therefore left untouched. TWO HYMNS TAKEN where the folder had none at all.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Αυγούστου — «Όσιος Ποίμην ο εν τω σπηλαίω ο Πολύπαθης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Its head line reads «Οσιος Ποιμην ο Εν Τω Σπηλαιω ο Πολυπαθης (; - 1110)», and the whole of its prose is one sentence: «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον Βίο του Οσίου παρά μόνο ότι ήταν Ρώσος μοναχός που κοιμήθηκε το 1110 μ.Χ.» — no details, except that he was a Russian monk who fell asleep in 1110. He is a separate man from `pimen-the-faster-of-the-caves`, whom the same listing carries as its own entry on this day and whom saint.gr dates to the fourteenth century: that one it calls ο Νηστευτής, the faster, and this one ο εν τω σπηλαίω ο Πολύπαθης, the one in the cave, the much-suffering. Nothing of the other folder is touched by this one. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page, which was grepped for there and not on the listing. The page prints no apolytikion and no kontakion, so this folder takes no hymn.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 20.08.2026 (7. август ст. ст.) — „Преп. Пимен Многоболезнени.“

attestations.note: The day’s fourth of five entries. His row was `undocumented` and the Greek line was this folder’s only book. **`dates` UNTOUCHED AND EXACTLY CORROBORATED.** The folder holds `death` 1110, flat, basis traditional; „Пред смрт устаде с постеље потпуно здрав, и одмах припреми себи гроб, и упокоји се у Господу 1110 год.“ — before his death he rose from his bed completely well, at once prepared his own grave, and reposed in the Lord in 1110 — gives the same year. A second source agreeing is not a reason to touch a stored date, and the basis is not promoted either: this book is a hagiographical calendar and not a document, so `traditional` is still what the interval is. **`types` UNTOUCHED.** Преп. is `venerable` and the folder has it; постригу га за монаха in „Ноћу му се јаве ангели и постригу га за монаха. Том приликом му рекну, да ће до смрти боловати, и да ће пред саму смрт оздравити. Тако и би.“ would give `monk`, which is there already and is a body word besides. Многоболезнени, much-ailing, is not a rank and is kept in the stored form, where it is the only thing distinguishing him from the three other Pimens of this corpus and from the faster of the same Lavra, whom the Greek keeps on this same day. **NO `related` ROW AND NO `locations`.** The entry names no person at all: the angels who tonsured him by night are angels, and „Донесен у Печерску лавру ради исцелења, он ту оста до смрти.“ brings him to the Caves Lavra for healing without naming anybody in it. The Lavra itself takes nothing — a dedication is not a relation, and `pimen-the-faster-of-the-caves` is a different man whom nothing in this entry mentions. Kyiv is in a clause. **WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS THAT THE GREEK LINE DID NOT**, which is the whole of this folder’s first life: „Од малена болешљив, и од малена жељан монаштва.“, sickly from childhood and longing for monasticism from childhood; „Он се више мољаше Богу за болест него за здравље.“, that he prayed to God for sickness rather than for health; „Ноћу му се јаве ангели и постригу га за монаха. Том приликом му рекну, да ће до смрти боловати, и да ће пред саму смрт оздравити. Тако и би.“, the tonsure by angels and their word that he would be ill until death and be made well just before it, and that so it was; „20 година лежао је у постељи.“, twenty years in bed; and „Чинио чудеса за живота и био необично прозорљив.“, wonders in his lifetime and an unusual clairvoyance. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion: the day carries the verse only, which is Bishop Nikolai’s own and belongs to no person. The ПЕСМА is thirty lines on the second entry, three sayings of Or on truthfulness and on thinking himself the worst of God’s creatures, and it is in no field and in no life (§3), read before this was written.

death.note: saint.gr: «ήταν Ρώσος μοναχός που κοιμήθηκε το 1110 μ.Χ.», and its head line «(; - 1110)». The page gives no year of birth.

hymns.text: Богоноснаго Антония смиренномудрием подражая, / терпением Иову подобяся, / не исцеления от болезни, но паче протяжения тоя / желал еси себе, терпеливодушне Пимене, / да не како, здрав быв / и от места сего родительми исторжен, / сожития преподобных и чина их лишишися, / тем паче надежды от самих Ангел пострижен был еси, / с нимиже моли Христа Бога / спастися душам нашим.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 7 августа ст. ст. — «Тропарь преподобного Пимена Многоболезненного, Печерского, в Ближних пещерах», глас 5

english.text: Imitating the God-bearing Antony in humility of mind and likened to Job in patience, thou didst desire for thyself not healing from thy sickness but rather its lengthening, O patient-souled Pimen, lest, being made whole and torn from this place by thy parents, thou shouldst lose the company of the venerable and their rank. Therefore, beyond all hope, thou wast tonsured by the Angels themselves; with them pray thou to Christ God that our souls be saved.

hymns.text: Долговременную болезнь благодарив претерпевшаго,/ приидите, сошедшеся, восхвалим Пимена многотерпеливаго,/ иже бо иногда за смрад в болезни бе гнушаемь,/ сей ныне благоухание испущает/ с верою к раце мощей его приходящим/ и прогонит злосмрадие страстей от вопиющих:/ прииди, Пимене, к нам, и ничтоже успеет враг на ны.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 7 августа ст. ст. — «Кондак преподобного Пимена Многоболезненного, Печерского, в Ближних пещерах», глас 6

english.text: Come, let us gather and praise Pimen the long-suffering, who endured a sickness of many years with thanksgiving; for he who was once shunned for the stench of his illness now gives out a sweet fragrance to those who come in faith to the shrine of his relics, and drives the foul odour of the passions from those who cry: come to us, Pimen, and the enemy shall prevail nothing against us.
